# Span `gen_ai.retrieval`

Operation: [GenAI Retrieval](/docs/gen-ai/retrieval.md)

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

Describes a retrieval operation - an execution of a framework retrieval pipeline that returns documents relevant to a query.

The span SHOULD cover the duration of the logical operation as observed by the
caller, starting when it is initiated and ending when the response is fully
received or the operation is terminated due to an error or cancellation.
If the operation is retried automatically, the span SHOULD cover all retries.

**Span name** SHOULD be `{gen_ai.operation.name}`.

**Span kind** SHOULD be `INTERNAL`.

**Span status** SHOULD follow the [Recording Errors](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.45.0/docs/general/recording-errors.md) document.

**Entity Associations** The span SHOULD be associated with one of the following entities:

- [`gen_ai.main_agent`](/docs/gen-ai/registry/entities/gen_ai.main_agent.md)

**Requirement level:** [Recommended](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.45.0/docs/general/signal-requirement-level.md).

**[1] `gen_ai.operation.name`:** SHOULD be `retrieval`.

**[2] `error.type`:** The `error.type` SHOULD match the error code returned by the Generative AI provider or the client library,
the canonical name of exception that occurred, or another low-cardinality error identifier.
Instrumentations SHOULD document the list of errors they report.

**[3] `gen_ai.retrieval.documents`:** Each document object SHOULD contain the following properties when available:
`id` (string): A unique identifier for the document, `score` (double): The relevance score of the document

This attribute MUST be recorded as an [AnyValue](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/common/#anyvalue) conforming to its [JSON schema](/model/gen-ai/gen-ai-retrieval-documents.json).

**[4] `gen_ai.retrieval.query.text`:**

> [!Warning]

and SHOULD be provided **at span creation time** (if provided at all):
